name: Sorbitan triisostearate
description: Sorbitan triisostearate (CAS 54392-27-7 ) is a lipophilic sorbitan ester derived from isostearic acid, functioning as a low-HLB emulsifier and rheology modifier across personal care, coatings, and industrial formulations. Its oil-soluble character makes it effective for stabilizing water-in-oil emulsions and controlling texture in anhydrous systems. In color cosmetics and skincare, it is used to bind pigments and improve spreadability. This additive provides a smooth skin feel in foundations, lipsticks, and sunscreens. Coatings and industrial lubricant formulators use it as a dispersant and consistency agent where oil-phase stability is critical. In textile processing, it functions as a softening and conditioning additive applied to fiber finishes and fabric treatments. Food-grade applications include its use as an emulsifier in fat-based systems. In these systems, it helps control crystallization and improve texture in confectionery coatings. Sorbitan triisostearate is supplied as a viscous liquid or paste at ambient temperature for easy handling. It is available in cosmetic-grade and technical-grade specifications to meet the requirements of personal care and industrial end markets. Food-grade supply conforming to relevant purity standards is also offered. Our material is manufactured to meet rigorous quality benchmarks for consistency and performance.
